description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 003 are an arabesque terracotta jali design, an ornate patterned clay screen shown in the product photo as a feature wall in a patio lounge, chosen when the wall itself should be the main decoration.

## How it looks
The photo shows a flowing, arabesque-style pattern rather than a plain grid. That kind of curving, interlaced design links back to the carved stone and clay screens of Mughal and Islamic architecture, and it tends to look richer the larger the wall. The terracotta colour stays warm and earthy, so the pattern reads clearly without paint.

## Where it works
- **Patterned jali feature wall** behind seating on a patio, rooftop or veranda.
- **Patio jali wall design** to separate a lounge from a lawn or parking area while keeping it airy.
- **Decorative clay jali** panels at an entrance, courtyard or stair landing.

Because the pattern is busy, it usually looks best against simple surroundings: plain plaster, a single floor finish and minimal furniture. Clay tends to weather gently outdoors, so the screen can age into the space.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Pattern: ornate arabesque-style (from a patio lounge photo)
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you set out the wall.

Lay out a few pieces dry before fixing so the pattern lines up across joints, and keep mortar off the visible face. Clean with water and a soft brush.

## See it before you order
An ornate design is easier to judge in person. Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm, or ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) and send your wall size for a dated quote. See the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of an arabesque terracotta jali wall?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Where does an ornate jali pattern look best?
faqs.a: Usually on one feature wall, such as behind patio seating or at an entrance, against plain plaster and simple flooring so the pattern stays the focus.

faqs.q: Arabesque jali or square grid jali: which should I choose?
faqs.a: A square grid looks modern and calm and suits large facades; an arabesque pattern is more decorative and traditional and suits feature walls. The choice depends on the style of the house.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 003" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
